findings.trigger: Worker requires reg[registration_sha256] equal digest of entire registration, making an ordinary frozen registration impossible or raising KeyError.
findings.fix: Pass external digest separately throughout; never require registration to contain its own hash.

findings.trigger: Final checkpoint registration_sha256 compared with checkpoint file SHA argument instead of registration digest.
findings.fix: Separate checkpoint_sha and registration_sha arguments and verify both, with unequal-digest regression.

findings.trigger: Initial next_episode_indices expected0 but actual native next indices1. Reset payload expected top-level indices/list but actual nested info mapping. Completed events emitted before all resets loses per-slot chronological ordering when multiple episodes complete in a rollout. Saved future-next indices are current+1, not completed-count.
findings.fix: Use real retained original episode journal shape as fixture; merge events by rollout_step/completed-before-reset at ties; validate each slot chain and final resume-next=current+1 after abandoning live episodes.

findings.trigger: Launcher requires top-level config_sha256 not emitted by checkpoint_payload; no inherited/cumulative counters saved despite promised120 cumulativeupdates.
findings.fix: Save exact config pin and inherited/cumulative counters, identity actual new run seed; preserve new-phase counters72.

findings.trigger: PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX empty string enables defaultcache, not bypass. Manifest path allowlist excludes frozen Torch/NumPy dependency inventory and D1 original terminal evidence.
findings.fix: Use real dedicated empty absolute prefix inherited launcher/worker, -B/no bytecode writes, inspect sys.pycache_prefix. Retain original dependency inventory pins and D1 evidence in allowed source manifest.

findings.trigger: Frozen numeric started_monotonic/deadline issued before source review spends experiment budget before execution; maintaining fresh hash afterward defeats reviewed registration identity.
findings.fix: Frozen timing policy with launcherT0 captured before full preflight; worker inherits same absoluteT0, derive1600/1800 deadlines once. PersistT0 in ownedlaunchreceipt; independentobserver retains raw inclusive1800bound. No restart/reset duringrun.

findings.trigger: Handler only latches, so signal after last finalization check and before final print/exit can still exit0. New launcher did not inherit all tested r3 protections merely by rerunning oldlauncher tests.
findings.fix: Bring audited r3 late-publication failure behavior into newlauncher and test actual newlauncher. Keep bounded directreaping and never signal after positivegroupabsence.

evidence_boundary: Source inspection only; no new experiment or model execution; real original telemetry fixture already retained.
